rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for computer-created or online substitutes, especially when the thing is simulated rather than physically present.

example.english: We use virtual reality to view flats, so we don't have to go in person.
example.traditional: 我哋用虛擬實境睇樓，唔使親身去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 heoi1 ji5 sat6 ging2 tai2 lau4 m4 sai2 can1 san1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when “virtual” means online or remote, contrasting internet-based activity with meeting in person; it does not specifically imply computer simulation.

example.english: The lecture is virtual this time, so nobody has to go to school.
example.traditional: 今次個講座網上舉行，大家唔使返學校。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gong2 zo6 mong5 soeng6 geoi2 hang4 daai6 gaa1 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6 haau6
